elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies assistance in connection with expiration and upon termination for any reason; the added data-return obligation also expressly applies after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The six-month continuation right applies only when Customer requests it at least 100 days before expiration. No six-month assistance period is provided following termination.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 requires all expenses and charges for Termination Assistance to be computed at M&I's then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires M&I to return all Customer Data within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The added clause specifies a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: The added clause first requires return and then requires deletion, with written certification, following completion of any Termination Assistance.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 and the added data-return clause expressly cover expiration and termination.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: No 90-day assistance period is guaranteed after both expiration and termination. The six-month continuation provision is conditioned on a request at least 100 days before expiration and does not cover termination.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: M&I must return all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination, satisfying the export requirement.
